author: National Geographic
description:
Witness devastating real life footage and hear witness accounts of deadly storms across the globe in this Gathering Storm MEGA episode. Featuring three, full episodes: 

Gulf Storms
The Gulf of Mexico is one of the busiest and most hurricane-prone areas in the U.S. Will this season bring the monster hurricane everyone fears?

Super Typhoon Terror
Super Typhoon Hagibis threatens devastation in Japan and causes havoc in the Bering Sea, and cameras in the midst capture the action.

Typhoon Alley
Super Typhoon Kammuri thunders toward the U.S. territory of Guam and on to the Philippines. This is what our cameras captured in the Western Pacific.
